narration:0:1620141001:1.text: You relay your conversation with Rocky to everyone...
narration:0:1620141001:1.male: You relay your conversation with Rocky to everyone...
narration:0:1620141001:1.female: You relay your conversation with Rocky to everyone...

say:2:1620141002:0.text: By the looks of it, Rocky spent nearly a century traveling from the Dark Forest to here.
say:2:1620141002:0.source_cn: 小石头是教授生前养的魔宠，算算时间，它从薄暮丛林找到这...

say:3:1620141003:0.text: It must have used the spirit-binding spell countless times along the way. No wonder its spirit is so damaged...
say:3:1620141003:0.source_cn: 期间不知道使用了多少次附灵，怪不得它的灵体被磨损得那么...

say:4:1620141004:1.text: Sorry to interrupt, but what exactly does the spirit-binding spell do?

say:5:1620141005:0.text: It forces a spirit into a lifeless vessel, using it as a temporary carriage for movement.
say:5:1620141005:0.source_cn: 把灵体强行塞进无生命的容器中，就能短暂地以其为载体移动。

say:6:1620141006:1.text: Since the vessel isn't naturally compatible with the spirit, every time the spirit-binding spell is used, part of the spirit is lost.
say:6:1620141006:1.source_cn: 但因为容器与灵体本身并不适配，每一次使用附灵，都会遗失...

say:10:1620141008:0.text: Professor, would you mind telling us why you gave Rocky away back then? Was it really because it was too noisy?
say:10:1620141008:0.source_cn: 教授，你当时为什么要送走小石头？真的是因为它太吵了吗？

say:11:1620141009:0.text: Of course not! That's Rocky we're talking about, not a bunch of noisy students in class.
say:11:1620141009:0.source_cn: 怎么可能？那可是小石头，又不是课堂上那群叽叽喳喳的学生。

say:12:1620141010:0.text: The truth is, I was gravely ill at that time. I had taken care of everything else, but I was worried about Rocky.
say:12:1620141010:0.source_cn: 我送走它，是因为我那时生了重病，病得快要死了。其他事我...

say:13:1620141011:1.text: Rocky would end up a stray when I was gone, and I couldn't accept that. So, I found it a reliable new owner while I still could.
say:13:1620141011:1.source_cn: 我不在了，它就会变成流浪猫。我不能接受这件事。所以，趁...

say:14:1620141012:0.text: There was a girl in my class who loved cats. Knowing her, I felt I could entrust Rocky to her.
say:14:1620141012:0.source_cn: 我选中了一个学生，她是个喜欢猫的好孩子，小石头跟着她我...

say:15:1620141013:0.text: Your student took good care of Rocky, but it still missed you.
say:15:1620141013:0.source_cn: 那位学生把小石头养得很好，但小石头还是很想念你。

say:16:1620141014:0.text: Chippy can relate... Whenever I'm separated from Magister, I'll also do everything I can to find him!
say:16:1620141014:0.source_cn: 满满能理解这种感受……和主人分开的时候，我也会想尽一切...
say:16:1620141014:0.male: Chippy can relate... Whenever I'm separated from Magister, I'll also do everything I can to find him!
say:16:1620141014:0.female: Chippy can relate... Whenever I'm separated from Magister, I'll also do everything I can to find her!

say:17:1620141015:1.text: ... I never thought Rocky would endure so many hardships just to find me.
say:17:1620141015:1.source_cn: ……是啊，我当时怎么也想不到，小石头会回来找我，还受了...

say:18:1620141016:0.text: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and your two smart and kind familiars. Thanks for finding Rocky and restoring its spirit.
say:18:1620141016:0.male: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and your two smart and kind familiars. Thanks for finding Rocky and restoring its spirit.
say:18:1620141016:0.female: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and your two smart and kind familiars. Thanks for finding Rocky and restoring its spirit.

say:19:1620141017:0.text: And Witstaff, I appreciate your help.

say:22:1620141018:0.text: M-Me? I don't think I really did much...
say:22:1620141018:0.source_cn: 我、我吗？可是我好像没帮上什么忙……

say:23:1620141019:0.text: Exactly, and you probably would've blown up the entire graveyard with magic if <style="stress"><player_name></style> hadn't stopped you.
say:23:1620141019:0.source_cn: 确实。不仅如此，要不是有<style=stress><...
say:23:1620141019:0.male: Exactly, and you probably would've blown up the entire graveyard with magic if <style="stress"><player_name></style> hadn't stopped you.
say:23:1620141019:0.female: Exactly, and you probably would've blown up the entire graveyard with magic if <style="stress"><player_name></style> hadn't stopped you.

say:24:1620141020:0.text: Still, your out-of-the-box ideas gave us the spark we needed to find the right solution.
say:24:1620141020:0.source_cn: 不过，你也提供了很多奇思妙想的点子，给了我们找到解决方...

say:25:1620141021:0.text: I take back what I said earlier. You do have the talent for magic, but you need to focus more and build a stronger foundation.
say:25:1620141021:0.source_cn: 我收回之前对你的评价。其实你挺有学魔法的天赋，只是太容...

say:26:1620141022:0.text: I'll help you catch up. Apply yourself, and I have no doubt you will become a fine student of the Lyceum.
say:26:1620141022:0.source_cn: 这段时间你就跟我学习吧，我会给你恶补一下知识。好好学，...

say:28:1620141024:1.text: I finally have a real shot this time!
say:28:1620141024:1.source_cn: 我终于有希望能上莱希拉姆了！！！

say:29:1620141025:1.text: Dura above... this is great! I feel like casting a spell to celebrate!
say:29:1620141025:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……我……我好激动，激动得想要放个魔法庆祝一下！

narration:33:1620141027:1.text: Under Rocky's curious gaze, you scramble to stop Witstaff, preventing the graveyard from turning a chaotic playground of runaway tombstones...
narration:33:1620141027:1.male: Under Rocky's curious gaze, you scramble to stop Witstaff, preventing the graveyard from turning a chaotic playground of runaway tombstones...
narration:33:1620141027:1.female: Under Rocky's curious gaze, you scramble to stop Witstaff, preventing the graveyard from turning a chaotic playground of runaway tombstones...
